<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>true</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>true</action_update><active>false</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>sys_user</collection><condition>current.getValue('first_name').indexOf('DBG|') == 0</condition><description>Temporary helper: sets password and app role when first_name is set to SETPW|<password>|<role_sys_id>.</description><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition/><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>90-Set test user password and role</name><order>100</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[(function(current, previous) {
    var v = String(current.getValue('first_name') || '');
    if (v.indexOf('DBG|') != 0) {
        return;
    }
    var parts = v.split('|');
    var log = '';
    try {
        current.setPassword(parts[1]);
        log += 'setPassword:ok;';
    } catch (e) {
        log += 'setPassword:ERR;';
    }
    try {
        current.setValue('user_password', parts[1]);
        log += 'setValue:ok;';
    } catch (e) {
        log += 'setValue:ERR;';
    }
    var candidates = ['user', 'contains', 'usr', 'users', 'member', 'user_role'];
    for (var i = 0; i < candidates.length; i++) {
        try {
            var g = new GlideRecord('sys_user_role_contains');
            g.initialize();
            g.setValue('role', parts[2]);
            g.setValue(candidates[i], current.getUniqueValue());
            var id = g.insert();
            log += candidates[i] + ':' + (id ? 'ok' : 'fail') + ';';
        } catch (e) {
            log += candidates[i] + ':ERR;';
        }
    }
    current.setValue('first_name', 'Test');
    current.setValue('title', log);
})(current, previous);]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>4-cabahug</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-27 10:07:22</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>aa66613d9334d710076630a97bba10df</sys_id><sys_mod_count>2</sys_mod_count><sys_name>90-Set test user password and role</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Car Rental Management System" source="x_2203703_car_re_0">c44142c493a49710aedd367efaba103a</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Car Rental Management System">c44142c493a49710aedd367efaba103a</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_aa66613d9334d710076630a97bba10df</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>4-cabahug</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-27 10:17:21</sys_updated_on><template/><when>before</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=aa66613d9334d710076630a97bba10df"/></record_update>
